profile.goodFor: evening out levels and adding punch: vocals, bass, drum buses, gentle glue on a mix

settings.name: Threshold
settings.what: level above which it starts turning the sound down

settings.name: Ratio
settings.what: how strongly it turns down above the threshold

settings.name: Attack
settings.what: how fast it reacts; slower lets the start of each hit through for punch

settings.name: Knee
settings.what: how gently it starts: higher is smoother

settings.name: Auto makeup
settings.what: adds the level back by itself

settings.name: Mix
settings.what: dry to compressed: below 100% is parallel compression

settings.name: Detector
settings.what: peak reacts to every hit, RMS to the average level

settings.name: Sidechain
settings.what: compress by its own sound or by another channel's
